title: Affine trivialization of one finite free sheaf retract
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open of X, and M a sheaf of O_U-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose M is a retract of O_U^m for some natural number m, with section i and retraction p satisfying i followed by p equals the identity. For each point x of U there is an affine open V containing x inside U and a natural number r such that the restriction of M to V is isomorphic to O_V^r. Rank zero is allowed.

source.place: Tag 00NX (3) implies (7); schemes.tex Tags 01IA and 01IB; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00NX and /tag/01IA

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood W of x contained in U. Map the given splitting through overMap, the overEquiv functor, and restriction along W.isoSpec.inv. The functors preserve finite coproducts and take the unit to the unit, so mapFreeIso identifies the ambient sheaf with a finite free sheaf on Spec Gamma(X,W). Functoriality preserves the splitting equation.

Apply the affine global-sections functor to the splitting. By tildeFinsupp and the tilde-Gamma unit its ambient module is the finite free module indexed by ULift(Fin m). Module.Finite.of_surjective and Module.Projective.of_split give finiteness and projectivity of the retract sections. Naturality of the affine counit (NatTrans.retractArrowApp) makes its component at the retract a retract of its invertible component at the free sheaf. Isomorphisms are stable under retracts; isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeGamma proves quasi-coherence. This is the private helper affine_retract_sections.

Represent x by a prime p of Gamma(X,W). Apply exists_localizationAway_equiv_finsupp_of_finite_projective to the finite projective module of sections, obtaining f outside p and an equivalence of its localization with Fin r ->0 Gamma(X,W)_f. Reindex by ULift(Fin r). This pointwise result suffices; no finite standard cover is needed.

Use Scheme.Modules.nonempty_restrict_iso_free_of_localizedModule to identify the restriction of the quasi-coherent sheaf to Spec Gamma(X,W)_f with the finite free sheaf on ULift(Fin r). The comparison uses sections-localization on principal opens and the affine counit. Since f is outside p, p lifts to a point of this localized spectrum.

Let k be the composite open immersion from the localized spectrum to X through W, and set V=k.opensRange. The lifted point maps to x, and V is affine and contained in W and U. Restrict the free-sheaf isomorphism along k.isoOpensRange.inv and compose restrictCompIso and restrictFreeIso. After cancellation against W.iota, this composite map into W equals X.homOfLE (V <= W). Apply overMapCompOverEquiv and mapFreeIso for overEquiv V, then its fully faithful preimageIso. Nested overMap restrictions are definitionally the single restriction from U to V.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Tags 00NX (3) implies (2) and (7), 01IA and 01IB; compiled B2 proof using the affine counit retract and the pointwise principal neighbourhood, with explicit restriction comparisons

from.place: single-index local trivialization, followed by proved finite induction

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_trivialization_of_finite_retract
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (hM : ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : M ⟶ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ M),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 M)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ ∃ hVU : V ≤ U, IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVU)).obj M ≅
          SheafOfModules.free
            (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))
